nodes.Technique: An adversary action or behavior at the atomic level (T-ID); may have sub-techniques.
nodes.SubTechnique: A more specific variant of a parent Technique (T-ID.NNN).
nodes.Tactic: A high-level adversary goal (TA-ID) such as Persistence or Exfiltration.
nodes.Group: A tracked threat actor or intrusion set (G-ID).
nodes.Software: A tool, malware, or utility used in attacks (S-ID).
nodes.Mitigation: A defensive measure that reduces technique risk (M-ID).
nodes.DataSource: A log or telemetry source that can detect technique activity (DS-ID).
nodes.DataComponent: A specific observable within a DataSource used for detection.
nodes.Campaign: A named series of intrusion activity attributed to a Group (C-ID).
nodes.Platform: An operating system or environment where techniques apply.

relationships.USES: A Group or Software uses a Technique/SubTechnique; a Technique uses Software.
relationships.MITIGATES: A Mitigation reduces risk for a Technique.
relationships.DETECTS: A DataComponent can detect a Technique.
relationships.ATTRIBUTED_TO: A Campaign is attributed to a Group.
relationships.TARGETS: A Group or Campaign targets a specific Platform.
